en.quote: [Serial production of the Zetta electric car] will begin by the end of the year. It will all depend on completion of development work.
en.head: Zetta did not enter series production in the stated year.
en.body: Manturov expected series production of the Zetta by the end of 2021, subject to completion of development work. By year-end he spoke instead of a first Russian series-produced EV in “the next year or two”. Zetta representatives said in 2024 that the project was still alive, but series production had not begun. The development condition matters to the comparison.
